item.tib: rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gsang dbang thugs rje'i gter rgyun
item.coloph: ces pas (pa'i) gsang dbang thugs rje'i gter rgyun zhes bya ba 'di yang / bka' babs bstan pa'i gsal byed/ snyigs dus kyi sngags 'chang / gar dbang bdud 'dul snying po dang / lung babs grogs po dge rgan shes rab phun tshogs dang / yang slob rang gam du gnas pa'i bla chung g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang po dang / btsun chung g.yung drung phun tshogs nas/ dar dkar dri med yug ring gis sna drangs nye bar bskul ba dang / yang slob sngags 'chang dpal sdis nas gus pa'i lha phyag dang bcas bskul ba la bstan (brten) nas/ snyigs dus kyi skabs su bab pa'i tshe dbang lung zin/ tshe dbang bde chen snying po 'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni/ g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa'i/ rgyal khams kyi khol po ba bdag gis snang sems zung 'jug rtsa thig rlung gi nyams len gyi thun 'tshams (mtshams) su/ gyer spungs rig 'dzin chen po'i zhal lung bzhin du spel zhing rgyud (brgyud) pa'o//
